findings.title: Yonhap News Agency original report (AKR20261028043952002)
findings.summary_md: Yonhap reported that Bithumb discovered the breach of its in-house mobile system on Tuesday and notified the Korea Internet & Security Agency and the Personal Information Protection Commission. The article states Bithumb was analyzing whether member data was involved and that the internal work system is separated from the virtual asset trading system.

findings.title: Reuters / 93.3 The Drive: Three South Korean financial firms including Bithumb report data breaches
findings.summary_md: Reuters via Yonhap said three South Korean financial firms reported data breaches on Wednesday. Bithumb said its in-house mobile system had been hacked and personal information leaked, as part of a wider wave hitting the country's financial sector.

findings.title: CoinTelegraph: Bithumb discloses data leak after internal system breach
findings.summary_md: CoinTelegraph reported the breach impacted Bithumb's in-house mobile system used by employees for work and information sharing. Bithumb told Yonhap it was investigating the exact scope, including whether member information was involved, and emphasized customer virtual assets could not be accessed through this breach.
